title: Your Body: Taking Care of That Divine Gift
author: Gail Newbold

footnotes.text: During a priesthood session of general conference, President Russell M. Nelson taught: “When Jesus asks you and me to ‘repent’ [seeLuke 13:3, 5], He is inviting us to change our mind, our knowledge, our spirit—even the way we breathe. He is asking us to change the way we love, think, serve, spend our time, treat our wives, teach our children, andeven care for our bodies” (“We Can Do Better and Be Better,”Liahona, May 2019, 67; emphasis added).
Russell M. Nelson, “Your Body: A Magnificent Gift to Cherish,”Liahona, Aug. 2019, 52.
